in_hebrew.name: Tamarra
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Tamarra הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Tamarra was a nymph who lived in palm trees. She was believed to protect and bless those who offered her sacrifices of palm fruits. In the Bible, Tamar is a woman of great faith who conceives a child through unconventional means.
